class.name: SourceMDLAnimationData
class.brief_description: Serialized Source MDL animation data used by the script-side Source MDL animation player.
class.description: Stores the parsed animation information needed by the script-side Source MDL animation player, including Source bone names, bone controllers, sequence metadata, IK metadata, and sampled animation tracks. Imported MDL scenes embed this resource so animation playback can work after scene reload without storing the original MDL, VTX, or VVD files. The data is intentionally exposed as editable Godot arrays and dictionaries so tools and game scripts can inspect, patch, replace, or augment imported Source animations. The default player is available at [code]modules/sourcepp/scripts/source_script_anim_player.gd[/code]. Script-side IK lifecycle helpers are available at [code]modules/sourcepp/scripts/source_ik_data.gd[/code], [code]source_ik_lock.gd[/code], and [code]source_ik_rule.gd[/code]. The script player also creates an [code]AnimBehaviours[/code] node under the imported MDL root. That node owns editable behavior [Resource] instances from [code]source_anim_behaviours.gd[/code], including default IK behavior resources for Source [code]IK_SELF[/code], [code]IK_WORLD[/code], [code]IK_GROUND[/code], [code]IK_RELEASE[/code], [code]IK_ATTACHMENT[/code], and [code]IK_UNLATCH[/code]. The same resource container is intended to host animation event behavior resources later.

method.name: find_animation_data_index
method.description: Returns the array index in [member animations_data] for the baked animation with the requested Source animation index, or [code]-1[/code] if it is not present.

method.name: find_sequence
method.description: Returns the index of the first sequence whose [code]label[/code] matches [param name], or [code]-1[/code] if no sequence matches.

method.name: get_animation
method.description: Returns one entry from [member animations_data]. The dictionary contains [code]animation_index[/code], [code]fps[/code], [code]frame_count[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]ik_rules[/code], and [code]tracks[/code]. Each IK rule contains Source timing, target, chain, slot, attachment, and ground/contact metadata. Each track contains [code]positions[/code] as a [PackedVector3Array] and [code]rotations[/code] as an [Array] of [Quaternion] values.

method.name: get_animation_by_index
method.description: Returns the baked animation dictionary with the requested Source animation index, or an empty dictionary if it is not present.

method.name: get_animation_count
method.description: Returns the number of baked sampled animations.

method.name: get_bone_controller
method.description: Returns one Source bone controller dictionary from [member bone_controllers_data]. The dictionary contains [code]bone[/code], [code]type[/code], [code]start[/code], [code]end[/code], [code]rest[/code], and [code]input_field[/code].

method.name: get_bone_controller_count
method.description: Returns the number of Source bone controller definitions.

method.name: get_bone_count
method.description: Returns the number of Source bones referenced by the animation tracks.

method.name: get_ik_autoplay_locks
method.description: Returns IK locks applied by autoplay sequences. Each lock dictionary contains [code]chain[/code], [code]position_weight[/code], [code]local_quaternion_weight[/code], and [code]flags[/code].

method.name: get_ik_chain
method.description: Returns one IK chain dictionary from [member ik_chains_data]. The dictionary contains [code]name[/code], [code]link_type[/code], and [code]links[/code]. Each link contains [code]bone[/code] and [code]knee_dir[/code].

method.name: get_ik_chain_count
method.description: Returns the number of Source IK chain definitions.

method.name: get_sequence
method.description: Returns one sequence dictionary from [member sequences_data]. The dictionary contains [code]label[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]group_size[/code], [code]param_index[/code], [code]param_start[/code], [code]param_end[/code], [code]animation_indices[/code], [code]ik_rules[/code], [code]events[/code], [code]auto_layers[/code], [code]bone_weights[/code], [code]pose_keys[/code], and [code]ik_locks[/code]. Sequence IK rules are flattened from referenced animation descriptors and annotated with [code]animation[/code] and [code]blend_cell[/code].

method.name: get_sequence_count
method.description: Returns the number of merged sequence descriptors, including sequences baked from included animation MDLs.

method.name: get_sequence_names
method.description: Returns sequence labels in sequence-index order.

method.name: get_summary
method.description: Returns a compact dictionary with source paths, data counts, and [code]has_required_data[/code]. This is useful for debug panels and import validation scripts.

method.name: get_track
method.description: Returns the sampled position and rotation arrays for [param bone] in the baked animation identified by [param animation_index], or an empty dictionary if the animation is missing.

method.name: has_required_data
method.description: Returns whether the resource contains bone names, sequence metadata, and sampled animation tracks.

members.member: Source path for the optional external animation block, when known.
Source bone names, used to map animation track indices onto the imported [Skeleton3D].
Serialized IK locks applied by autoplay sequences.
Source path for the imported MDL.
Serialized Source sequence descriptors, events, blend grids, autolayers, bone weights, and IK locks.
